description: Search the 2026 Virgin Islands Code section by section, by words or by citation (e.g. "1 V.I.C. § 254"). Use for questions about what the Code says. Returns up to 10 sections, each with its citation, title, heading, a short excerpt and its page on usvipublicrecords.com; get_code_section gives a section's full text. The words together as written rank first, then every word, then some. The text is an unofficial word-for-word copy of the 2026 edition as found, for reference, not for legal reliance, and every answer says so; acts passed after the edition are not reflected.

query.description: Words, or a citation such as "33 V.I.C. § 3021" or "title 3 section 551".

title.description: Only this title of the Code: "1" to "34", or "11A", "12A", "15A".
